--+
MESSAGES   OF   THE   PRESIDENT
QUEZON I Volume 4
The changes herein made Shall take effect on April  1,1941.
Done in the City of Baguio, this lst day of April, in the year of Our Lord, Nineteen hundred and
forty-one, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the sixth.
(SGD.) MANUEL L. QUEZON
By the President:
(SGD.) ]ORGE 8. VARGAS
Secretary to the President
